events.title: Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods
events.description: Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday. Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico. By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted. Continue reading...

events.title: Lebanon faces uncertainty as UNIFIL mandate nears end
events.description: As UN peacekeeping forces prepare to withdraw from Lebanon, Israel remains present and Hezbollah is still armed. A new EU support mission aims to strengthen Lebanon's army, but will not replace UN peacekeepers.

events.title: Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro tied ahead of runoff vote
events.description: With just under a week to go before the decisive presidential runoff election, polls show left-wing incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his right-wing challenger Flavio Bolsonaro are virtually tied.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Brazil's Lula, Flavio Bolsonaro tied ahead of runoff vote

events.title: Wagner brothers begin new NBA chapter on different paths
events.description: After five years, brothers Franz and Moritz Wagner are no longer playing together for the Orlando Magic. In the new NBA season, their separation will likely mean the new "German" team is the Charlotte Hornets.

events.title: Brutal, revolutionary empire builder: Genghis Khan's legacy
events.description: Berlin is host to a major exhibition on the founder of the Mongol Empire and his successors. Here's how Genghis Khan disrupted the course of history.

events.title: Japan probe sets course for Mars moon
events.description: The MMX spacecraft is on its way to Mars' moon Phobos to collect surface samples that could help answer long-standing questions about the formation of the Solar System.

events.title: India news: Rubio holds talks with counterpart Jaishankar
events.description: Marco Rubio's talks with Indian Foreign Minister Jaishankar come as the two countries struggle to finalize a trade deal.

events.title: Boeing's 737 Max 10 finally wins FAA approval after years of delays
events.description: Boeing's largest 737 Max jet has cleared a major regulatory hurdle, with US aviation authorities approving the Max 10 for passenger service on Tuesday after nearly a decade of delays. The certification marks a boost for the planemaker's recovery, with deliveries expected to begin in 2027.

events.title: Trump's approval rating hits new record low as US midterms loom
events.description: Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a record low - indicating that next month's midterm elections could be punishing for the Republicans.

events.title: Doomsday cult leader found guilty of murdering 190 children and one adult
events.description: Doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie, his wife Rhoda Maweu, and 29 other co-accused have been found guilty of the murder of 190 children and one adult.

events.title: Pakistani authorities arrest man accused in $126 million US postage fraud scheme
events.description: Pakistan has arrested a man accused of running an online counterfeit postage operation that U.S. prosecutors say caused more than $126 million in losses to the U.S. Postal Service

events.title: A former South Africa deputy police chief facing sexual offense charges is denied bail
events.description: A South African court has denied bail to former deputy police chief Shadrack Sibiya, who faces charges of sexual offenses
events.ticker_label: 💥 A former South Africa deputy police chief facing sexual offense charges is denied bail

events.title: Meta tells Brazil's electoral court it treats Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro equally ahead of Sunday vote
events.description: Tech giant Meta said on Tuesday it has complied with an order of Brazil’s electoral court for it to give equal treatment in its platforms to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and opposition candidate Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of the Oct. 25 runoff for t...
events.ticker_label: 💥 Meta tells Brazil's electoral court it treats Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro equally ahead of Sunday vote

events.title: Bosnian Serb authorities boost neighboring Serbia's populist leader ahead of a key election
events.description: Serbia's populist leader Aleksandar Vucic faces a key parliamentary election this weekend

events.title: 2 men rearrested in UK on suspicion of assisting Iran over suspected plot at a US-run air base
events.description: British police have rearrested two men suspected of assisting Iran’s intelligence service in a plot at a U.S.-run air base

events.title: Pompeii's grandest house gets a $1.6 million restoration funded by private sponsor
events.description: A private home in Pompeii, believed to be the grandest, is being restored with 1.4 million euros ($1.6 million) from a private sponsor

events.title: Alberta separatists say they'll keep fighting after independence vote
events.description: One of Alberta’s leading separatists has vowed to continue the independence movement even if voters reject a proposal Monday to begin the process of leaving Canada

events.title: Bangladesh: UNICEF chief calls for an end to child marriage
events.description: At 14, Bushra faced being married off – until community leaders at a UNICEF-supported child protection hub worked with her father to prevent her from being given away against her will.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Bangladesh: UNICEF chief calls for an end to child marriage

events.title: Guterres honours Indonesian troops who paid ‘ultimate sacrifice’
events.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres paid tribute to Indonesian peacekeepers on Monday, laying a wreath in honour of four who recently lost their lives in Lebanon and offering a robust defence of UN peacekeeping in what he called “testing times for peace”.

events.title: Protecting Earth’s fragile biodiversity takes spotlight at Armenia talks
events.description: Biodiversity losses continue to upend the lives of billions of people whose future prosperity depends on countries taking urgent action to protect our planet, the top UN official leading talks at the UN Biodiversity Conference in Yerevan, said on Monday.

events.title: Honduran illegal immigrant charged with assaulting ICE officers with hammer during New Jersey traffic stop
events.description: Reinieri De Jesus Licona Amador allegedly grabbed a hammer and swung it at ICE officers during a New Jersey traffic stop before being pepper sprayed.

events.title: Convicted bank robber returns to old tricks with ‘old man’ mask in Florida heists, feds say
events.description: David Sartin Jr. allegedly robbed two Florida banks in a prosthetic "old man" mask weeks after starting supervised release from a 10-year bank robbery sentence.

events.title: Madison Brooks rape suspect's attorney held in contempt for using her name to try to ban pink in courtroom
events.description: Caitlin Fowlkes was held in contempt for using Madison Brooks' full name in a court filing tied to her motion to ban pink from the courtroom.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Madison Brooks rape suspect's attorney held in contempt for using her name to try to ban pink in courtroom

events.title: American who fled US after allegedly killing pregnant wife could return within days with murder charge dropped
events.description: Italy granted Lee Gilley partial extradition on a reduced first-degree murder charge, but his defense attorney says an appeal is likely coming.

events.title: UNC settles Trump admin probes into alleged campus antisemitism, race-based admissions

events.title: Alberta holds non-binding separation vote as independence fight grips Canada
events.description: About 3 million Albertans are eligible to vote in the non-binding separation referendum, but polls show deep divisions within the UCP over it.

events.title: Pope Leo welcomed back as he delivers Angelus prayer days after lung cancer surgery
events.description: Thousands gathered in St. Peter's Square as Pope Leo XIV made a surprise early return from Gemelli hospital following cancerous tumor removal.

events.title: European Parliament votes to confront Muslim Brotherhood, 'Islamist entryism' in overwhelming vote
events.description: The European Parliament voted 'historic' 381-167 to condemn Islamist entryism and Muslim Brotherhood influence as critics say the hard part will be converting the resolution into legislation.
